what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Armenia in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9155 Armenian asylum seekers in the United States, 64.4% of all asylum seekers from Armenia.
Refugees from Armenia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Armenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1686 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 13911, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
